name: Chilling Love
source:
This visual novel is a romantic tale seen through the eyes of Aurora, named after the Aurora Borealis on account of her brilliant hair which mimics this wondrous light show. With just a glance you can tell that she is not an ordinary human, but one that possesses innate magical abilities. That is because she is half Rukh, a magical race of extraordinary beings who range from monstrous manifestations of evil to just fuzzy little animals. No matter their shape or size they are seen as agents of chaos that should keep to their own world, the Spirit World, and away from humans.

That's what Aurora grew up hearing. Rukh and humans should never come together as one but she is a living contradiction to that rule. Maybe that's why she always had a soft spot for Rukh. But she'd never challenge others in her village on this front and just accept it. That was until she met her beloved.

[From [url=https://fava-beans.itch.io/muwhahaha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述了通过奥罗拉（Aurora）的眼睛看到的浪漫故事，奥罗拉（Aurora Borealis）因其绚丽的头发模仿了这种奇妙的灯光秀而得名。一看就知道她不是普通人类，而是拥有与生俱来的魔法能力的人。这是因为她有一半鲁克血统，这是一个由非凡生物组成的神奇种族，他们的范围从邪恶的怪物到毛茸茸的小动物。无论它们的形状或大小如何，它们都被视为混乱的代理人，应该留在自己的世界，即精神世界，并远离人类。

这就是奥罗拉从小听到大的事。鲁克和人类永远不应该结合在一起，但她是这一规则的活生生的矛盾者。也许这就是为什么她总是对Rukh情有独钟。但她从来不会在这方面挑战村里的其他人，只是接受它。直到她遇到了心爱的人。

[来自[url=https://fava-beans.itch.io/muwhahaha]Itch.io[/url]]
